name: hinged_soap_case
description: 100 x 64 x 32 mm travel soap case, closed: a tray and a lid of about the same depth joined by a thin web on one long side, with a thumb tab on the other.
generator: generate_hinged_soap_case.py (procedural grid of hexahedra cut into tetrahedra, cell part labels)
construction: Tensor-product hexahedral grid, six tetrahedra per cell, plan corners rounded by moving vertices

metadata.origin: Centre of the tray footprint at z=0
metadata.tuning_status: Source estimates; no latch or lip, no simulation run. Needs lid-to-tray contact and a per-scene hinge stiffness.
